speaker: Doctor
text: I see you recently treated acute sinusitis with antibiotics, but now you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever. Did you take any of your medications as prescribed, or did you stop early?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any chills, nausea, or changes in the color or odor of your urine since starting the antibiotics?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis secondary to antibiotic-induced allergic interstitial nephritis.

Please confirm if you have noticed any blood in your urine or difficulty urinating. REQUEST IMAGES: Kidney Ultrasound.
